objective: Close root finding S3 by binding every selected production operation to one canonical time/memory/physical-I/O order row, exact counter formulas and boundaries, 1x/3x/10x fixtures, and a versioned shared Rust/Python conformance corpus without changing product behavior.

risk.rationale: The candidate is docs/corpus/test-only, but it defines cross-runtime asymptotic and budget truth used by final capability and lifecycle evidence; semantic drift would invalidate closure.

disallowed_actions: Create a manifest or launch while any exact input remains UNBOUND
Modify product code, counter formulas, capability declarations, issue state, or lifecycle state
Use helper-only fixtures or qualitative O-notation without production counters and boundaries
Infer Rust/Python parity from one runtime
Accept a table row without a fixture or a fixture without one canonical row
Run unrelated broad product gates on an unchanged product tree

non_goals: Launch before exact metrics acceptance and integration
Add unrelated benchmarks or performance claims
Review devcontainer, CI, host, packaging, or agent wrappers

invariants.statement: The candidate begins only from exact accepted and integrated metrics projection plus stable accepted production call graphs, counters, profiles, and selected operations.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one identity UNBOUND, change one product byte, or use an unaccepted counter formula; status must remain blocked.

invariants.statement: Every canonical time/memory/I-O order row maps to production counters, budgets, exact boundaries, and 1x/3x/10x fixtures, and every fixture maps back to one row.
invariants.falsification_test: Delete either side, alter an order/formula on only one side, or pass through an unrelated limit; validation must fail.

invariants.statement: One versioned deterministic corpus is consumed by Rust and Python with identical canonical outcomes or one explicit reviewed runtime-specific distinction.
invariants.falsification_test: Change one runtime outcome, omit a selected surface, or change version/digest without lineage; conformance must fail.

invariants.statement: The candidate changes only declared docs, corpus, schema, and test paths; any product defect returns to the preceding packet.
invariants.falsification_test: Add codefire or crates product bytes to the diff; review must return BLOCK.

validation.command: Recompute accepted metrics and runtime/successor identities, reports, selected operations, counters, profiles, changed paths, and clean state.
validation.purpose: Prevent documentation of moving or rejected behavior.

validation.command: Run both runtime corpus consumers, exact/minus-one/plus-one and 1x/3x/10x production fixtures, mutation matrix, schema/lineage/digest checks, and canonical docs checks.
validation.purpose: Prove the table and corpus are semantic evidence rather than prose.

validation.command: Freeze exact parent/head/tree/patch/write-set/log digests and clean status; reject any product path.
A fresh independent Fugu session reviews only the immutable candidate and every S3/table/corpus counterexample.
